title: privacy_mask
description: Obscures fixed regions and detected objects in decoded RGB24 or grayscale frames before they reach later plugins.

frame_width.description: Width in pixels of incoming frames; frames pass unmasked while this is 0.

frame_height.description: Height in pixels of incoming frames; frames pass unmasked while this is 0.

mode.description: How masked areas are drawn; unrecognised values fall back to black.

blur_size.description: Blur radius or pixelate block size in pixels; values below 1 are raised to 1.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to mask; empty or absent means all streams.

regions.description: Fixed polygons to mask on every frame; polygons with fewer than three points are ignored.

items.description: A polygon as a list of [x, y] points in frame pixels.

dynamic.description: Masks boxes reported by upstream detector events; absent means dynamic masking is off.

enabled.description: Turn dynamic masking on when the dynamic object is present.

sources.description: Event types whose boxes are masked.

classes.description: Detection labels to mask for detection and tracked_detection events; empty means all labels.

min_confidence.description: Minimum detection confidence to mask; face and plate boxes are always masked.

padding.description: Extra margin added on each side of a box, as a fraction of its size; negative values become 0.

hold_ms.description: Reuse boxes from frames up to this many milliseconds away; negative values become 0.

person_region.description: Mask the whole person box or only its top part; any value other than head means body.

head_fraction.description: Top fraction of a person box masked when person_region is head.
